title: A Few Good Men · The courtroom confrontation
description: The full courtroom exchange from the supplied clip, with synthetic speech, a warm courtroom and animated wireframe characters.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You snotty little bastard.

cues.speaker: ross
cues.text: Your Honor, I'd like to ask for a recess.

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: I'd like an answer to the question, Judge.

cues.speaker: judge
cues.text: The court will wait for an answer.

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: If Lieutenant Kendrick gave an order

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: that Santiago wasn't to be touched,

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: then why did he have to be transferred?

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: Colonel, Lieutenant Kendrick ordered the code red, didn't he?

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: Because that's what you told Lieutenant Kendrick to do.

cues.speaker: ross
cues.text: Objection!

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: And when it went bad, you cut these guys loose!

cues.speaker: ross
cues.text: Your Honor!

cues.speaker: ross
cues.text: Your Honor!

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: You doctored the logbook!

cues.speaker: judge
cues.text: Lieutenant Kaffee!

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: You coerced the doctor!

cues.speaker: judge
cues.text: Consider yourself in contempt!

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: Colonel Jessep, did you order the Code Red?

cues.speaker: ross
cues.text: You don't have to answer that question.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: I'll answer the question.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You want answers?

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: I think I'm entitled to.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You want answers?

cues.speaker: kaffee
cues.text: I want the truth.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You can’t handle the truth!

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: Son, we live in a world that has walls,

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: and those walls have to be guarded by men with guns.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: Who's going to do it?

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You?

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You, Lieutenant Weinberg?

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: I have a greater responsibility than you can possibly fathom.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You weep for Santiago and you curse the Marines.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You have that luxury. You have the luxury of not knowing what I know.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: That Santiago's death while tragic probably saved lives.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: And my existence while grotesque and incomprehensible to you saves lives.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You don't want the truth because deep down in places you don't talk about at

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: parties, you want me on that wall.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You need me on that wall.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: We use words like honor, code, loyalty.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: We use these words as the backbone

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: of a life spent defending something.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: You use them as a punchline.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: I have neither the time nor the inclination

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: to explain myself to a man who rises and sleeps

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: under the blanket of the very freedom that I provide

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: and then questions the manner in which I provide it.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: I would rather you just said thank you

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: and went on your way.

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: Otherwise, I suggest you pick up a weapon and stand a post. Either way,

cues.speaker: jessep
cues.text: I don't give a damn what you think you are entitled to!
Did you order the code red?

cues.text: I did the job.
cues.speaker: jessep

cues.text: Did you order the code red?

cues.text: You're goddamn right I did!
